title: conversations.message_read v1 (event payload)
description: Published by the conversations module, in the transaction that stores a read of one message, once per layer that produced something: `structured` (the sender's own machine-readable dates, read with no model) or `model` (Scout's one `complete` read of the message). The schedule module turns `items` (things that happen at a time) into events on the inbox owner's Campbooks calendar; the tasks module turns `asks` (obligations of the reader) into tasks. Ids, enums, keys and times only: no title, place, quote, amount or other text; a reader fetches them through `conversations.get_message_read` with their own access, and the schedule module through the `texts` blob. Keys are stable for the same message and position, so a repeated delivery changes nothing for a consumer. Workspace-scoped.

workspace.description: The workspace id (the event bus keys deliveries by it).

owner.description: The inbox's personal owner (a user id): the only member who reads it. Absent for a shared inbox, which gets no Scout events.

summary_ready.description: Whether the read holds a summary of the message (written when a need was open).

texts.description: The `read-texts` v1 document, a blob of the workspace that the message holds (deleted with it): the title, place and calendar UID of each item, by its key. The schedule module reads it to name the events it makes. Present only when an item has any; the text is never in the event.

key.description: `<message id>:<layer>:item:<position>` or `<message id>:<layer>:ask:<position>`, positions from 1 in the order the layer read them. The layer is part of the key, so the structured and the model reads of one message never share one.

when.description: An RFC 3339 time with an offset, or a date when the item lasts whole days.

time_zone.description: An IANA time zone name, checked against the database.

updates.description: The key of an earlier item of the same conversation that this one changes.

cancels.description: The key of an earlier item of the same conversation that this one cancels.

has_amount.description: Whether the read holds an amount (pay only); the amount itself is not here.

same_as.description: The reference of an open task this ask repeats, as the OpenTasks port gave it.

done_by.description: How the ask gets done: `reply` when replying to the message is itself how, `elsewhere` when it is done some other way. Optional: absent from a structured read and from a read made before it was asked. An enum, no text.
